identification: Box of roughly 100-150 used 7-inch 45 rpm singles in worn paper sleeves. Two Japanese picture-sleeve pressings are visible at the front: (1) Paul McCartney & Wings 'Live and Let Die' / 007 Japanese issue (Japanese title 007 死ぬのは奴らだ, Odeon/Apple, price code visible; catalogue number looks like EPR-10786 or EAR-10401 but is not legible), and (2) The Beatles 'All You Need Is Love' / 'Baby You're a Rich Man' Japanese Odeon picture sleeve (Odeon logo bottom left; likely OR-1763 or a later reissue), with a plastic sleeve, in good condition. Other sleeves show a 'New Kids' title, a purple 'M...' sleeve and more Japanese-text sleeves. The rest of the box is unidentified commercial 45s.

viewing_check: Estimate $60-90, current bid $25. The value is in the Japanese pressings; plain used 45s sell in bulk at roughly A$0.50-1.20 each. Andy should look at both Japanese sleeves' catalogue numbers and vinyl colour (red wax Beatles copies bring A$65, black A$15-22), check for more Japanese or picture-sleeve singles lower in the box, and condition (box looks worn, sleeves foxed). Sold prices are 0-2.5 years old and flat or slightly up. Two Japanese singles may be worth A$30-80 together; the other 100+ singles roughly A$50-75 as a bulk lot.
